slate.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one non-tiling dark SLATE message panel for a 1993 painted VGA dungeon crawler. Very wide horizontal slab, target150x34 pixels. Orthographic face-on. Near-black blue-grey slate, subtly chipped irregular outer rim, a hairline muted verdigris mineral inset near one short end. Broad quiet stone surface, naturally unique wear, NO repeating tiles or brick pattern. Centre completely calm and very dark for two cream text lines. No baked writing, icons, dividers or controls. Handmade understated pixel-painterly material, no glossy modern effects. Flat uniform lighting, opaque material fills whole image. Wide landscape composition.

derivation: Nearest reduction, shared fixed palette, binary alpha. Code reserves quiet text/map fields and fixed HP liquid aperture; second candle flame and hanging chain are native pixel drawings. Full-panel paints are non-tiling; mockups preserve screenshot lighting colours.
